lastTask: Implement Byte 14 audible song form with developed chorus

projectState.summary: Byte 14 pivots from infrastructure to audible song form and passed Claude's listening review. The branch adds default Verse/Chorus/Verse/Chorus/Bridge/Chorus form data, a looping `sectionAtBeat` arrangement timeline, a deterministic in-scale chorus melody committed before lookahead scheduling, verse/chorus/bridge behavior through the note-decision path, and a synced Session inspector/status section readout. Live probe confirmed the first chorus at beat 32 with `section:chorus` / `section:developed-chorus` melody events (`G5`, `C5`, `Bb5`). After review, the bridge feel fix removed the second fire-time octave lift so bridge melody stays around octave 5 from committed material.
